sources.entry: jieba - The most popular Chinese text segmentation library.

summary.one_liner: jieba is a popular Python library for segmenting Chinese text into words, with keyword extraction, POS tagging, and custom dictionary support.
summary.what_it_does: Splits Chinese sentences into words using a prefix dictionary, a DAG of candidate words, dynamic programming for the most probable path, and an HMM with Viterbi for unknown words. Offers accurate, full, and search-engine cut modes, plus an optional PaddlePaddle-based mode. Lets users load custom dictionaries and add, delete, or re-weight words at runtime. Includes TF-IDF and TextRank keyword extraction, part-of-speech tagging compatible with ictclas labels, and token start/end positions. Also provides a command-line interface and a parallel mode using multiprocessing (not on Windows).
use_cases: Chinese word segmentation for text analysis
building search indexes for Chinese documents
adding domain-specific terms to Chinese segmentation
segmenting large Chinese text files from the command line
how_to_run: print('/'.join(jieba.cut('我来到北京清华大学', cut_all=False)))
notable: Four segmentation modes: accurate, full, search engine, and PaddlePaddle deep-learning mode
Unknown-word recognition via HMM with Viterbi algorithm
Runtime dictionary tuning with add_word, del_word, and suggest_freq
TF-IDF and TextRank keyword extraction plus POS tagging
Lazy dictionary loading and command-line interface
caveats: Parallel segmentation is not supported on Windows
Paddle mode requires installing paddlepaddle-tiny==1.6.1 separately
Automatically computed word frequencies may be ineffective when HMM new-word discovery is used
